prompt:
Create one edge-to-edge desktop web-app interface screenshot for GO Itaim “Dashboard Geral”, landscape 16:10, about 1440×900. Show only the application canvas: absolutely no browser chrome, window title bar, traffic-light buttons, address bar, browser tabs, laptop, phone, or frame. Use the attached GO Itaim logo as the exact image asset in the sidebar; do not draw a substitute.

Visual direction: a live gate board translated into a delivery operations comparison page. Fixed column geometry, aligned tabular numerals, horizontal rules, sharp rectangular table rows, and a selected row that stays in place. Light neutral canvas, charcoal type, exact GO cobalt for active navigation and chart line, one small amber edge on the selected row. Contemporary operational grotesk and tabular figures. Do not use aviation icons, airport scenery, flights, luggage, gates, or travel copy.

Application structure and visible terms:
- Fixed 238px left sidebar with logo and title “Dashboard Geral”.
- Exact menu: “Principal” with “Visão Geral”, “Análise”, “UTR”, “Comparação”; “Operacional” with “Entregadores”, “Valores”, “Prioridade | Promo”, “Evolução”, “Dedicado”; “Marketing” with “Operacional Marketing”, “Marketing”. Select “Visão Geral”.
- Top application bar only: “Praça: Todas”, “2026 · Semanas 05–07”, “Amostra ilustrativa”.
- Heading “Resumo Operacional”. Align three first-read values horizontally: “Corridas ofertadas 18.450”, “Aderência 74,8%”, “Praças 2”.
- Lower content: a large table named “Por praça”, with columns “Praça”, “Corridas”, “Aderência”, “Semana anterior”; rows “Guarulhos”, “Centro”, “Total”. Highlight the Guarulhos row with a thin amber left edge as a simple selected row; do not add any status label or unconfirmed state.
- Beside it show a smaller calm line chart “Evolução diária”, legend “Ofertadas” and “Aceitas”.
- Keep demonstration rows plausible and consistent with 18.450, and display no additional metrics, statuses, or unverified features.

The table's period-aligned columns are the visual signature: changes stay associated with their original plaza row instead of disappearing and returning elsewhere. The task must read as comparing delivery operations by period. Use correct Brazilian Portuguese.
